Sculptra and PLLA: Uses, Safety & Evidence

Sculptra is a poly-L-lactic acid-based injectable used for certain specified aesthetic indications, subject to product labelling and local authorisation. It should not be described as a proven breast-enlargement product.

Home/Non-surgical/Sculptra / PLLA

Understanding Sculptra means understanding its intended approved uses, the difference between collagen-stimulation claims and actual breast augmentation, and the importance of respecting product-specific contraindications and instructions.
